# Generic factory calls and independent static scope

The owned inputs retain producer/result, element and direct-seed factory
contracts, mutable callbacks, exact initialization/failure behavior, reference
identities, wide flags, original later casts and allocation counts.

`--generic-owner` adds a class formal named `T` while each public static method
declares its own `T`. Frozen reflection observers verify distinct declaring
scopes without initializing the provider. Source and SDK profiles compile all
recovered Java and compare every original definition, metadata and Exceptions.
Existing malformed-signature and independently compiled wrong programs retain
their original checks. No private sample data is included.
